    (= (travel-time benighat-shelter kalika-temple) 8) (= (travel-time kalika-temple benighat-shelter) 8)
    (damaged benighat-shelter kalika-temple) (damaged kalika-temple benighat-shelter)

    (road jwalamukhi-care-home nilkantha-farm) (road nilkantha-farm jwalamukhi-care-home)
    (= (travel-time jwalamukhi-care-home nilkantha-farm) 19) (= (travel-time nilkantha-farm jwalamukhi-care-home) 19)

    (road benighat-shelter nilkantha-farm) (road nilkantha-farm benighat-shelter)
    (= (travel-time benighat-shelter nilkantha-farm) 22) (= (travel-time nilkantha-farm benighat-shelter) 22)

    ;; evacuation points
    (evac-point benighat-shelter)
    (evac-point dhunche-hospital)

    (free-seats car2 n4)
    (carrying car2 injured n0) (carrying car2 child n0) (carrying car2 elderly n0) (carrying car2 adult n0)

    ;; waiting people
    (waiting likhu-village adult n4)
    (waiting likhu-village injured n4)
    (waiting nilkantha-farm adult n1)
    (waiting nilkantha-farm injured n2)
    (waiting kalika-temple elderly n2)

    ;; arithmetic
    (sum n0 n0 n0) (sum n0 n1 n1) (sum n0 n2 n2) (sum n0 n3 n3) (sum n0 n4 n4)
    (sum n1 n0 n1) (sum n1 n1 n2) (sum n1 n2 n3) (sum n1 n3 n4)
    (sum n2 n0 n2) (sum n2 n1 n3) (sum n2 n2 n4)
    (sum n3 n0 n3) (sum n3 n1 n4)
    (sum n4 n0 n4)
    (positive n1) (positive n2) (positive n3) (positive n4)

    ;; defer costs
    (= (defer-cost injured n1) 80) (= (defer-cost injured n2) 160)
    (= (defer-cost injured n3) 240) (= (defer-cost injured n4) 320)
    (= (defer-cost child n1) 60) (= (defer-cost child n2) 120)
    (= (defer-cost child n3) 180) (= (defer-cost child n4) 240)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n1) 50) (= (defer-cost elderly n2) 100)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n3) 150) (= (defer-cost elderly n4) 200)
    (= (defer-cost adult n1) 20) (= (defer-cost adult n2) 40)
    (= (defer-cost adult n3) 60) (= (defer-cost adult n4) 80)

    (= (total-cost) 0))

  (:goal (and
    (waiting likhu-village adult n0)
    (waiting likhu-village injured n0)
    (waiting nilkantha-farm adult n0)
    (waiting nilkantha-farm injured n0)
    (waiting kalika-temple elderly n0)

)
